question.text: As per SEBI (AIF) Regulations, a Custodian:

answer.text: Can be a related party to the sponsors or designated partners without conditions
Shall NOT be a related party to sponsors or designated partners unless specific conditions are fulfilled

explanation.text: **The Logic:** Per Section 4.2.3, Custodian shall not be a related party to sponsors/designated partners unless specific conditions are fulfilled. **The Trap:** Opposite or mandate restrictions are incorrect. **Cross-Exam Context:** Standard independence principle. **Distributor's Pro-Tip:** Document why the Custodian is unrelated — this is a CTR item.
